variant: C: SKU, categories, thresholds, and replenishment

domain_invariants.requirement: All resource ids are immutable positive integers; non-positive path resource ids are 404, while non-positive body and query reference ids are validation errors.
Categories have unique name 2..80 and optional parent without cycles
Products have unique SKU ^[A-Z0-9-]{3,32}$, name 2..160, category, and active boolean
A reorder rule is unique by product-location with reorder_point 0..1000000 and target_level strictly greater
Candidates are computed locally where available stock is at or below reorder point
Deactivating products is prohibited while active reorder rules exist
Only admins manage categories, SKU, and rules; users may read
All lists use ascending immutable id pagination with limit 1..100 default 20 and after_id greater than zero, returning nullable next_after_id.

seed_data: Roles are user and admin; GET /health is public and all private routes require valid local Bearer authentication with deny-by-default.
Writes require application/json; malformed JSON is 400, unsupported media type 415, and declared-field violations 422.
The specification is local and deterministic without network, filesystem, upload, or external dependency; 500 and 503 leave state unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /health publicly with no authorization, accepting no input; it shall validate local persistence availability, make no persistent change, and emit only 200 or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetHealth(request):
    // REQ-8-009; preconditions: none; authorization: public.
    IF local persistence fails THEN RETURN 503. END IF; RETURN 200.
    Transaction: none; postcondition: state unchanged; errors have no effect.
